page.notes: Printed text is heavily worn; several words in the Greek and in the running head are uncertain. The reference "Act. xi. xii." is read as printed in the text and may be damaged. Words such as "ebulliunt", "absurda", "Apostaticum" and some Greek letters are doubtful.
